about.heading: About Me
about.bio:
I'm a Python developer with hands-on experience in Django-based backend development, REST and GraphQL APIs, and database-driven web applications. My work centers on declaration workflows, business validations, and data processing systems for platforms that businesses rely on daily.

I enjoy working closely with a team to turn complex business rules into clean, dependable code — and I'm looking to keep growing as a developer inside a product that ships.

skills.heading: Skills
skills.subheading: Everything I build with, gathered in one place.

points: Develop and maintain backend functionality for Dubai-based customs declaration platforms using Python, Django, and PostgreSQL — covering APIs, business logic, declaration workflows, and database operations.

Built declaration pool management, team management, audit trail tracking, and advanced search, plus declaration ownership, access management, and integration of user/business info through external APIs.
Developed web applications and designed websites, handling both frontend and backend tasks.
Trained students in Python, Django, C#, ASP.NET (MVC), REST API, Bootstrap, HTML, and CSS.

projects.heading: Projects
projects.subheading: A few systems I've built end to end.

items.title: Declaration Management System
items.description: A Python/Django customs-declaration platform for Dubai Customs, managing import/export declarations — creation, amendment, document management, cargo details, and customer records.

items.title: Customs Declaration Management (CDM)
items.description: A system for processing customs declarations and their workflows — Declaration Pool, Team Management, Audit Trail, Advanced Search, and access management.

items.title: Traffic Rule Violation Detection
items.description: A real-time system detecting smoking, mobile usage, and driver drowsiness from a custom dataset, built for traffic surveillance and road safety.

items.title: Digital Menu
items.description: A mobile-responsive commercial web application handling Products, Price, and Orders modules for a restaurant-style ordering flow.
